system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Managed Instance Group with autoscaling (min 1, max 5) behind an HTTPS Load Balancer.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Managed Instance Group with autoscaling (min 1, max 5) behind an HTTPS Load Balancer.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
- path: instance-template.jinja

resources:
- name: mig-instance-template
  type: instance-template.jinja
  properties:
    machineType: e2-medium
    imageFamily: ubuntu-2004-lts
    imageProject: ubuntu-os-cloud
    network: default
    subnetwork: default
    tags:
      - http-server
      - https-server
    metadata:
      items:
        - key: startup-script
          value: |
            #!/bin/bash
            apt-get update
            apt-get install -y nginx
            systemctl start nginx
            systemctl enable nginx

- name: mig-instance-group
  type: compute.v1.instanceGroupManager
  properties:
    zone: us-central1-a
    instanceTemplate: $(ref.mig-instance-template.selfLink)
    targetSize: 1
    baseInstanceName: mig-instance
    namedPorts:
      - name: http
        port: 80

- name: mig-autoscaler
  type: compute.v1.autoscaler
  properties:
    zone: us-central1-a
    target: $(ref.mig-instance-group.selfLink)
    autoscalingPolicy:
      minNumReplicas: 1
      maxNumReplicas: 5
      cpuUtilization:
        utilizationTarget: 0.6
      coolDownPeriodSec: 60

- name: health-check
  type: compute.v1.healthCheck
  properties:
    type: HTTP
    httpHealthCheck:
      port: 80
      requestPath: /
    checkIntervalSec: 5
    timeoutSec: 5
    healthyThreshold: 2
    unhealthyThreshold: 3

- name: backend-service
  type: compute.v1.backendService
  properties:
    backends:
      - group: $(ref.mig-instance-group.instanceGroup)
    healthChecks:
      - $(ref.health-check.selfLink)
    protocol: HTTP
    portName: http
    timeoutSec: 30
    connectionDraining:
      drainingTimeoutSec: 300

- name: url-map
  type: compute.v1.urlMap
  properties:
    defaultService: $(ref.backend-service.selfLink)

- name: ssl-certificate
  type: compute.v1.sslCertificate
  properties:
    certificate: |
      -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
      MIICljCCAX4CCQD+dummy+certificate+data+replace+with+real+cert
      -----END CERTIFICATE-----
    privateKey: |
      -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
      MIIEvQIBADANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAASCBKcwggSjAgEAAoIBAQC7+dummy+key
      -----END PRIVATE KEY-----

- name: target-https-proxy
  type: compute.v1.targetHttpsProxy
  properties:
    urlMap: $(ref.url-map.selfLink)
    sslCertificates:
      - $(ref.ssl-certificate.selfLink)

- name: forwarding-rule
  type: compute.v1.globalForwardingRule
  properties:
    IPProtocol: TCP
    portRange: 443
    target: $(ref.target-https-proxy.selfLink)
